resources.string: You only need to do this once. AlertBot will then ring this phone whenever something goes wrong.
So the team knows which phone this is.
Ask your manager if you don\'t have one.
That PIN isn\'t right. Check it and try again.
Can\'t reach AlertBot. Check your internet connection and try again.
Too many wrong PINs. Wait a few minutes and try again.
AlertBot isn\'t ready for sign-ins yet. Ask your administrator to finish setting it up.
Signed in, but this phone couldn\'t get a notification token. Alarms may not arrive.
Your manager will give you the PIN. You won\'t need to enter it again on this phone.
Alarms are not switched on for this server yet. You won\'t be woken until an administrator enables them.
Signed in, but this phone wasn\'t given access to alerts. Ask your administrator to check the AlertBot setup.
Make sure you can be woken
Android can silence apps overnight. Three quick checks so that never happens to AlertBot.
Without this, nothing appears on your screen.
Stops the phone from putting AlertBot to sleep.
Show alarms over the lock screen
Lets an alarm wake the screen without you unlocking first.
Nothing needs attention right now. You\'ll be alerted the moment something goes wrong.
Can\'t reach the server. Showing what was last loaded.
Couldn\'t acknowledge. Tap to try again.
Acknowledging stops the alarm on every phone and tells the team you\'re on it.
This phone will ring for every open alert.
This rings every phone signed in to AlertBot, and appears in the alert history until someone acknowledges it. Use it to prove alarms are working.
Test sent. Waiting for it to reach this phone…
The test alarm reached this phone. Alerts are working.
The server created the test alert, but no alarm reached this phone. Ask an administrator to check that push notifications are switched on.
Snoozed. This will ring again in 5 minutes unless it\'s acknowledged.
